opening.argument: The visible material shows a WooCommerce tool for importing AliExpress products, not a request for financial participation. Its description says users can add products to a shop and convert product links to affiliate links. The administrative screens show product search filters, import settings, and selected products with an import control. Those details support a software demonstration: the money-making reference concerns an affiliate program, while the shown workflow concerns managing shop products and links. No request for payment or credentials, or deceptive financial participation, appears in the supplied material. Frame coverage is sparse, so behavior outside what is shown remains unaddressed.

citations.quote: Woo Aliexpress allows you to add thousands of AliExpress.com products to your woocommerce shop just by one click!
Convert all product links to affiliate links
